authorization: Root explicitly approved on 2026-10-08 before any prospective held-out run: union top ten across all three retrieval methods and both releases, plus independently reviewed source anchors. No brief, relevance grade, acceptance threshold or source expectation is changed.
rationale: Complete independent review of every scored top-ten candidate is required. Actual R1 development union: 335 candidate-brief pairs at top ten versus 613 at top twenty; two changed evidence versions approximately double that workload before new enriched-only entrants. This amendment prioritises complete source review over a larger partly unjudged pool.
knownReferenceRecall: Retain actual ranking positions through twenty; always include independently accepted source anchors in review, whether retrieved or absent. Unreviewed rank11-20 candidates receive no relevance grade and cannot enter nDCG/precision as assumed negatives.
